From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From a- +‎ cadere.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ak.kaˈde.re/
  • Rhymes: -ere
  • Hyphenation: ac‧ca‧dé‧re

Verb

[edit]

accadére (third-person only, third-person singular present accàde, third-person singular past historic accàdde, past participle accadùto, third-person singular future accadrà, auxiliary èssere) (intransitive)

  1. to happen
    Synonym: succedere
    Nessuno sapeva esattamente cosa fosse accaduto.
    No one knew exactly what had happened.
